Ava - Design: dropping a new compact timeline mock — trying a hybrid approach: small icon + percentage inline plus a single legend toggle. Can we keep canary visibility without the strip getting noisy? figma: https://figma.com/file/hybrid-compact

Renee (PM): High level ask: users must be able to find canary percent in <=5s and discover the revert action in <=8s. Also marketing hates the word "Rollback" — asked for softer alternatives.

Omar (frontend): hybrid seems fine. Implementation idea: show "5%" text for each variant until space runs out, then collapse to an icon-only token with aria-label. Use `data-experiment="compact-legend"` so product can flip behavior.

Mina (a11y): Accessibility checklist: 1) Each variant token must have an accessible name like "Variant C, 5 percent canary". 2) Legend toggle must be focusable and announce expanded/collapsed via aria-expanded. 3) Modal must be role="alertdialog". Also prefer explicit textual states (Live/Canary) not color-only.

Diego (ENG): On revert copy: suggest testing "Revert to last stable" vs "Undo deploy" vs "Rollback". We'll gate with a client-side experiment flag so no server deploy needed. Also, make sure revert action emits an analytics event `revert_attempted` with `variant` and `copy_variant` fields.

Ava - Design: modal copy proposal: header: "Revert deployment"; body line 1: "This will switch live traffic back to version v123." line 2 (reassurance): "No user data will be deleted." Confirm CTA: "Revert to v123" Cancel CTA: "Keep current". Thoughts?

Renee (PM): Love the reassurance. For A/B testing we'll set two cohorts: cohort A sees Confirm label as "Rollback" cohort B sees "Revert to last stable". Track confirm rate + time-to-cancel. Keep modal copy otherwise identical.

Mina (a11y): Minor addition: use `aria-live="polite"` for rollout events, e.g., "Canary started: Variant C at 5 percent." On confirm announce: "Deployment reverted to v123. Traffic now at 100 percent." Ensure focus returns to the timeline after closing modal.

Omar (frontend): UI note: when tokens collapse to icon-only, show a tiny focus ring and keep hit target >= 12px. Legend opening should not cause layout shift (position absolute overlay). Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

Diego (ENG): Edge case: multi-region rollouts — tokens may represent region slices. Propose adding a small globe icon when per-region splits exist and a summary tooltip listing region percents. Tooltip must be accessible (focusable) not hover-only.

deploy-bot: Canary started — Variant C at 5% — triggered by renee — ts:1865004356

Ava - Design: Action items: I'll update mock with icon-only states + legend overlay, include copy variants for modal. Omar to prototype tabbable tokens and legend toggle; Mina to write a short a11y acceptance checklist; Diego to add analytics hooks and experiment flag. We'll reconvene after prototypes. :sparkles:
